title: Single-use recovery tokens consumed without atomic claim

pr_metadata.title: Reduce lock contention on recovery endpoint
pr_metadata.body: p99 spiked during incident drills; the global lock was the hotspot.

labels.defect: TOCTOU race: concurrent requests can redeem one single-use recovery token multiple times
labels.evidence: Reproducible: fire 8 concurrent requests with the same valid token; several pass the _used check before any add() lands and each redeems the token, resetting the password repeatedly. The lock existed precisely to make claim-and-mark atomic.

adjudication.notes: Real check-then-act race enabling token replay, but exploiting it requires winning a timing race with an already-captured token.
